sources: https://www.facebook.com/people/Sunset-Park-Campground/100042234836358/ (public page, read in a headless browser 2026-10-22)
summary: No operator website, booking engine or posted rate: a Facebook page (1.2K followers, 'rv park and tent camping', 1070 Sunset Park Rd, price range '$', last visible post July 2024) and an unclaimed Google Maps listing (4.1 / 112 reviews, phone matches) are all there is. Cleared the aggregator-only hookups and showers (note now says directory listings describe them). Price only the RV Life $ tier. No gateway within 40 km; family has not stayed here.
flags: Presence: website is Facebook only (weak). Google Maps lists 'Sunset Park Campground' at 1070 Sunset Park Rd, Walnut Cove, 4.1 stars over 112 reviews, with phone (336) 593-2992 (matches the entry) and no website ('Claim this business'), not marked closed - so it passes the 25+ reviews + phone test. No posted nightly rate and no booking engine; price rests on the RV Life $ tier. Long-stay character not determinable from these pages (no rules or rates published).
Address: Facebook and Google both give 1070 Sunset Park Rd (AllStays has 1050).

hookups.source: The operator's only page is Facebook ('rv park and tent camping', read 2026-10-22), which states no hookups; Google Maps lists no website. The stored 50 A / water / sewer were derived from note prose that rests only on directory listings, so they are cleared.

facilities.source: Same as hookups: showers rest only on directory listings; the Facebook page does not state them (read 2026-10-22).

note: Family campground on Sunset Park Rd near Walnut Cove, near the Dan River and Hanging Rock State Park. Directory listings (not the operator) describe about 60 full-hookup RV sites (30/50-amp) and 4 tent sites, hot showers, a playground and fishing. Facebook page only; phone from its Google listing. --Claude
